organization.name: watchfloor quant lab
organization.mission: Operate a paper-only multi-agent trading laboratory with institutional separation of duties, measurable mandates, and human Mode-B governance — never silent live execution.
organization.scope: Paper trading organization; research, risk, governance, learning loops

mission.value: Operate a paper-only multi-agent trading laboratory with institutional separation of duties, measurable mandates, and human Mode-B governance — never silent live execution.

clarification_questions: What external capital / customer mandate applies beyond the paper lab?
Which regulatory jurisdiction constraints apply if this ever leaves paper?
What numeric success targets define 'effective' for the trading lab?
Where is the production broker boundary — never, sandbox-only, or future gated?
intent.rule: Do not guess mission, constraints, ownership, risk tolerance, or success criteria

akb_consultation.title: Propose ≠ Approve ≠ Execute
akb_consultation.summary: Trading organizations must separate proposal, approval, and execution into distinct workers with veto paths.

akb_consultation.title: Human-in-the-loop Mode B thresholds
akb_consultation.summary: Auto-approve below thresholds; hard escalate above. Human retains veto.

akb_consultation.title: Paper-first with live hard-disabled
akb_consultation.summary: Do not enable live execution until rollback, recon, and audit prove readiness.

akb_consultation.title: Change request lifecycle
akb_consultation.summary: draft → review → approved → scheduled → deployed → verified → closed/rollback

akb_consultation.title: Evidence package before quant promotion
akb_consultation.summary: Quant/Rentec-style seats require OOS evidence packages before promotion; builders never self-certify.

akb_consultation.title: Universal best topology myth
akb_consultation.summary: No topology is universally best; select by intent, cost, failure modes.

akb_write_policy.reason: AKB updates require reviewed organizational outcomes with evidence, applicability bounds, version, and steward approval — not unverified simulation/recommendation alone (source=pre_outcome).
